topic: The spinner who dismissed every great batsman with a single delivery style
hook: One delivery style. Every great batsman dismissed.
script: One delivery style. Every great batsman dismissed. Shane Warne's ball of the century to Mike Gatting in 1993 set the tone for a career of impossibility. It spun a foot. Beat the bat. Hit off stump. Gatting stared at the pitch in disbelief. Warne went on to take 708 Test wickets. All with that same wrist. Follow for cricket genius that borders on witchcraft.
